reviewMethod: Manual content review of all 150 preferred/rejected pairs across 75 original partition B contexts. Source quotations, warranted abstention, useful operations, read-only facts, observation assumptions, required inputs, and rejection inferiority reviewed individually. Hash and quote checks only bind the reviewed material; they do not substitute for semantic judgment.
exposureStatement: Reviewed partition B author module, prospective design and runner audit schema only. No partition A cases, development/final cases, model outputs, other reviews, or arm keys consulted.
